summary: Iteration 128 - Compliance Register & Laundry Management fully tested. All 26 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified with all components loading correctly, data displaying properly, and all data-testid selectors working. Fixed MongoDB conflict bug in laundry stock update endpoint.

features: Returns 7 default categories: fire, food, hs, license, insurance, gdpr, training
Each category includes total/overdue/expiring_soon counts
Categories have name, icon, and color properties

endpoints: POST /api/compliance/items/all - creates item with computed status based on due_date
DELETE /api/compliance/items/all/{id} - removes item; 404 on unknown id
features: Status computation: due_date < today => 'overdue'
Status computation: due_date within 30 days => 'expiring_soon'
Status computation: due_date > 30 days => 'compliant'
Returns 400 when title is missing
Delete returns 404 for unknown id
Create/update/delete require admin/manager role
Returns 11 default items: bed_sheet_single/double/king, pillow_case, duvet_cover, bath_towel, hand_towel, face_cloth, bath_mat, table_cloth, napkin

endpoints: POST /api/laundry/dispatches/all - creates dispatch with status='sent' and auto-adjusts stock
POST /api/laundry/dispatches/all/{id}/receive - moves items from in_transit to on_hand_clean
features: Dispatch creation auto-calculates total_cost from items
Stock adjustment: on_hand_clean -= qty_sent, in_transit += qty_sent
Receive flow: in_transit -= qty_sent, on_hand_clean += qty_received
Returns 400 when vendor or items missing
Merges DB stock with default catalog items
Each row has total = on_hand_clean + dirty + in_transit

endpoints: POST /api/laundry/contracts/all - creates contract with rate card
DELETE /api/laundry/contracts/all/{id} - removes contract; 404 on unknown id
features: Contract includes vendor, contact info, dates, pickup_schedule, terms, rates array
Returns 400 when vendor missing
Delete returns 404 for unknown id
Contracts require admin/manager role

features_verified: 5 KPI cards: Total Items, Compliant, Expiring ≤30d, Overdue, Action Needed
7 category pills with icons and colors
Dialog has title input, due date input, category select, frequency select, submit button
5 KPI cards: Items Sent (YTD), Sent, Received, Active Contracts, Total Spend
Dispatches tab: table with vendor, sent date, items count, cost, status, receive button
Stock tab: 11 rows with editable Clean/Dirty/Damaged inputs, read-only In Transit, calculated Total
Contracts tab: contract cards with vendor, contact, dates, rates, delete button
New Dispatch dialog: vendor input, add item button, item selector, qty/rate inputs
New Contract dialog: vendor input, pickup schedule, contact fields, date range, rate card, terms
Sidebar nav items present: Compliance, Laundry
Both nav items clickable and navigate to correct views

bug_fixed.issue: MongoDB WriteError when updating stock with 'name' field - conflict between $set and $setOnInsert
bug_fixed.fix: Removed 'name' from $setOnInsert when it's already in $set updates

critical_code_review_comments: All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
All endpoints properly protected with role-based authentication
Compliance status computation correctly handles overdue (past due), expiring_soon (within 30 days), and compliant (>30 days)
Laundry dispatch creation correctly auto-adjusts stock (clean -= qty_sent, in_transit += qty_sent)
Laundry receive flow correctly moves items back (in_transit -= qty_sent, clean += qty_received)
Stock endpoint correctly merges DB records with default catalog items
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed compliance items and laundry dispatches/contracts for testing, cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 128 tested Compliance Register and Laundry Management features. Compliance: 7 categories (fire, food, hs, license, insurance, gdpr, training), status computation based on due_date (overdue if past, expiring_soon if within 30 days, compliant otherwise), CRUD with check endpoint.
